ships.name: Focus
ships.archive_note: The hull everyone is issued and almost nobody keeps. It goes where it is pointed, which the Index considers its finest quality.

lines.display: Back to basics. Just you, me, and the dark.

cues.text: Just you, me, and the dark.

lines.display: The one they hand everyone. You made it yours, though.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [fond] The one they hand everyone. [pause] You made it yours, though.

ships.name: Flicker
ships.archive_note: Leaves a wedge of itself behind on every turn, as if it cannot commit to being in one place. The Index filed it twice by accident.

cues.text: Stay put long enough for me to find you.

ships.name: Ember
ships.archive_note: Twin exhaust lines that never touch and never drift apart. The engineers called it a design choice. Nobody believed them.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [measured, approving] Ember. Two lines, one direction. Very disciplined.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [measured, flat] Ember. Twin traces. [beat] They never touch.

lines.display: Ember. Keep those lines parallel.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [gentle instruction] Ember. Keep those lines parallel.

ships.name: Saber
ships.archive_note: Looks thin enough to slip through anything. It cannot, same as everyone. It leaves a violet cut in the dark that heals in under a second.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [dry, amused] Saber. Sharp choice. [beat] Try not to cut yourself.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [focused, quiet] Saber. Slice through. Don't scrape.

ships.name: Wisp
ships.archive_note: Sheds small pieces of itself as it flies and appears not to mind. Inspections found nothing missing.

cues.text: You're leaving bits of yourself everywhere again.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [nostalgic, curious] Haven't flown the Wisp in a while. Still smokes like that?

cues.text: Haven't flown the Wisp in a while.

ships.name: Pulse
ships.archive_note: Its trail beats in even blue intervals, like something keeping time for nobody in particular.

cues.text: Count the beats if you get nervous.

ships.name: Quill
ships.archive_note: Writes a fading blue line wherever it goes. The Index tried to read it once. It said nothing, very neatly.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [warm, encouraging] Quill. Let's write something worth reading.

ships.name: Fletch
ships.archive_note: Burns hot at the tip and cools to teal at the tail. Built for one clean flight in one straight line, which it has never once been given.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [earnest, then wry] Fletch. Fly true. [beat] Or at least fly.

lines.display: Fletch. One ribbon. It cools to teal.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [dry, amused] Fletch. Straight lines are overrated anyway.

ships.name: Nyan
ships.archive_note: Trails seven colors where one would do. The Index requested an explanation. The hull did not provide one.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [deadpan] Nyan. Subtle as ever.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [amused, approving] Nyan. Everyone's going to see you coming. [beat] Good.

cues.text: Everyone's going to see you coming.

ships.name: Shard
ships.archive_note: Its wake comes out jagged, like a crack running through glass. It flies perfectly well. It just remembers being broken.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [careful, low] Shard. Careful. Edges everywhere.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [nostalgic, warm] Haven't heard the Shard crackle in ages.

cues.text: Haven't heard the Shard crackle in ages.

ships.name: Halo
ships.archive_note: Two small moons circle it at all times. Nobody installed them. They will not leave.

lines.display: Halo. Say hi to the little ones for me.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [sweet, playful] Halo. Say hi to the little ones for me.

cues.text: Say hi to the little ones for me.

ships.name: Needle

lines.display: Needle. Thread it.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, precise] Needle. Thread it.

lines.display: Needle. Less hull, more nerve.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [quietly impressed] Needle. Less hull, more nerve.

ships.name: Echo
ships.archive_note: Every turn is drawn twice, a moment apart. The second line is never quite sure about the first.

lines.display: Echo. Echo.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [playful] Echo. [pause, quieter, like an echo] Echo.

lines.display: Echo. Everything you do, it says twice.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [amused] Echo. Everything you do, it says twice.

cues.text: Everything you do, it says twice.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [dry, wry] Echo. I'll only say this once, then.

cues.text: I'll only say this once, then.

ships.name: Dusk
ships.archive_note: Sheds violet sparks that fall like the end of a day nobody scheduled. Best flown when no one is watching.

lines.display: Dusk. My favorite hour.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, dreamy] Dusk. My favorite hour.

lines.display: Dusk. Purple sparks, quiet sky. Very romantic of you.

lines.display: Dusk. Feels late, doesn't it.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [quiet, wistful] Dusk. Feels late, doesn't it.

ships.name: Seal
ships.archive_note: A leaf-shaped hull that stitches a dotted line behind it, as if sewing the dark back up after passing through. Polite, for a ship.

lines.display: Seal. Stitch it up behind you.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [gentle] Seal. Stitch it up behind you.

lines.display: Seal. Tidy. I approve.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [approving, crisp] Seal. Tidy. I approve.

lines.display: Seal. Close every door you open.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [softly wise] Seal. Close every door you open.

ships.name: Hatch
ships.archive_note: Square, stubborn, and shaded in like a draftsman's homework. Turns as if it has been asked a personal question.

lines.display: Hatch. The square one. Respect.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [mock-serious] Hatch. The square one. [beat] Respect.

lines.display: Hatch. Corners first, grace later.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [dry] Hatch. Corners first, grace later.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [nostalgic, teasing] Haven't taken the Hatch out in ages. Still blocky?

cues.text: Haven't taken the Hatch out in ages.

ships.name: Trace
ships.archive_note: A square that leaves almost nothing behind. The Index confirmed that it flew. It could not confirm much else.

lines.display: Trace. Leave no trace. Ha.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [deadpan] Trace. Leave no trace. [small laugh] Ha.

lines.display: Trace. Barely a line. I'll squint.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [squinting, amused] Trace. Barely a line. I'll squint.

lines.display: Trace. Light hands tonight.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, delicate] Trace. Light hands tonight.

ships.name: Ring
ships.archive_note: Leaves a tunnel of rings, each a little smaller than the last. From behind, it always looks like it is arriving.

lines.display: Ring. Tunnel vision. The good kind.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [warm, amused] Ring. Tunnel vision. The good kind.

lines.display: Ring. Leave me a tunnel to follow you home.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [tender] Ring. Leave me a tunnel to follow you home.

cues.text: Leave me a tunnel to follow you home.

lines.display: Ring. Hello, loops.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [cheerful, light] Ring. Hello, loops.

ships.name: Fold
ships.archive_note: Folded from a single sheet, if the Index is to be believed. Its trail crinkles like paper that has been opened too many times.

lines.display: Fold. Crisp edges tonight.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [crisp] Fold. Crisp edges tonight.

lines.display: Fold. Don't crumple.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [gentle warning] Fold. Don't crumple.

lines.display: Fold. Paper wings, steel nerves.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [admiring] Fold. Paper wings, steel nerves.

ships.name: Mote
ships.archive_note: Trailed by a cloud of dust it insists is part of the design. Mostly harmless, the record adds, for reasons it does not give.

lines.display: Mote. Little speck. Big sky.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft wonder] Mote. Little speck. Big sky.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [conspiratorial, whispering] Mote. You're dusty. I won't tell.

lines.display: Mote. Small things make it through. Sometimes only them.

ships.name: Spine
ships.archive_note: Grows a ribcage of light as it flies. Something about it suggests it once belonged to something much larger.

lines.display: Spine. Show some.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [dry, encouraging] Spine. Show some.

lines.display: Spine. Bones made of light. Lovely, and a bit grim.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, a little haunted] Spine. Bones made of light. [beat] Lovely, and a bit grim.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [playful instruction] Spine. Stand up straight. [beat] Fly crooked.

ships.name: Orbit
ships.archive_note: Coils around its own path as if it lost something there. Flight logs show it never goes back.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [light, rhythmic] Orbit. Spiral, but forward.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [sing-song, soft] Orbit. Round and round, and onward.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [affectionate] Orbit. Don't get dizzy on me.

ships.name: Ink
ships.archive_note: Every turn is a brushstroke, heavy at the start and dry at the end. The Index listed it under hulls, crossed that out, and wrote "calligraphy".

lines.display: Ink. Make it a good stroke.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [calm, artistic] Ink. Make it a good stroke.

lines.display: Ink. The dark's your page.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [low, intimate] Ink. The dark's your page.

lines.display: Ink. Press firm on the turns.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [gentle instruction] Ink. Press firm on the turns.

ships.name: Flux
ships.archive_note: Its thin blue line wavers between solid and dotted, as if it has not made up its mind about existing. It has. Mostly.

lines.display: Flux. Make up your mind out there.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [teasing, patient] Flux. Make up your mind out there.

cues.text: Make up your mind out there.

lines.display: Flux. Flickering again. Stay with me.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [softly concerned] Flux. Flickering again. Stay with me.

lines.display: Flux. Changeable. Like weather. Like me.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [wry, self-aware] Flux. Changeable. Like weather. [beat] Like me.

ships.name: Cinder
ships.archive_note: Burns low and brown, dropping embers it never seems to miss. Older than its records. Possibly older than the records of its records.

lines.display: Cinder. Slow burn tonight.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [low, unhurried] Cinder. Slow burn tonight.

lines.display: Cinder. Smells like old engines, I'm told.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [amused, wistful] Cinder. Smells like old engines, [beat] I'm told.

cues.text: Smells like old engines, I'm told.

lines.display: Cinder. Haven't seen those embers in ages.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [nostalgic, warm] Cinder. Haven't seen those embers in ages.

cues.text: Haven't seen those embers in ages.

ships.name: Lantern
ships.archive_note: Drifts like something from a deep ocean, trailing lit tendrils. It is not looking for anything. It lights the way anyway.

lines.display: Lantern. Light the way.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, reverent] Lantern. Light the way.

lines.display: Lantern. Bring the glow.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [hushed, awed] Lantern. Like something that lives where light doesn't.

ships.name: Bloom
ships.archive_note: Opens at launch and stays open. Pink rings follow it as if it is still flowering. The Index found this unnecessary and kept it anyway.

lines.display: Bloom. Somebody dressed up.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [playful, impressed] Bloom. Somebody dressed up.

lines.display: Bloom. Go grow somewhere.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [sweet, teasing] Bloom. Go grow somewhere.

lines.display: Bloom. Flowers in space. Why not.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [amused, shrugging] Bloom. Flowers in space. [beat] Why not.

ships.name: Lyra
ships.archive_note: A four-point star dragging a ribbon of every cool color the archive has a word for. Named after something that used to sing.

lines.display: Lyra. Sing for me.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, longing] Lyra. Sing for me.

lines.display: Lyra. Brightest thing out here. Almost.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [warm, playful] Lyra. Brightest thing out here. [pause] Almost.

ships.archive_note: Sheds green flecks like seeds scattered on rock. Nothing has grown from them yet. The hull remains optimistic.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [soft, bittersweet] Sprout. Nothing grows here. [pause] It doesn't know that.

ships.name: Plume

lines.display: Plume. Burn bright.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [bright, energetic] Plume. Burn bright.

lines.display: Plume. You're on fire. Literally.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [amused] Plume. You're on fire. [beat] Literally.

lines.display: Plume. Turn up the heat.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [playful, warm] Plume. Turn up the heat.

ships.name: Koi
ships.archive_note: Swims more than it flies, trailing red speckles like scales. Said to bring luck, a claim the Index has filed under "pending".

lines.display: Koi. Swim upstream.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [gentle] Koi. Swim upstream.

lines.display: Koi. Lucky fish. We'll take it.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [light, hopeful] Koi. Lucky fish. We'll take it.

lines.display: Koi. Haven't seen it swim in ages.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [nostalgic, delighted] Koi. Haven't seen it swim in ages.

cues.text: Haven't seen it swim in ages.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [mock-cautious] Spore. Try not to spread.

lines.display: Spore. A mushroom in space. Fine. Fine.

lines.display: Spore. Leave some color behind.
lines.elevenlabs_input: [warm] Spore. Leave some color behind.

ships.name: Boreal
ships.archive_note: Pulls a ribbon of northern light behind a crescent hull. It was modeled on a sky the Index has never seen, from a record it does not discuss.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [low, intimate] Boreal. Cold colors, warm hands.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [sleepy, warm] Luna. Moonlight shift tonight.

lines.elevenlabs_input: [nostalgic] Luna. Haven't flown under the moon in ages.
